options.name: force
options.description: Only updates an existing macro if set to C(yes).

options.name: macro_description
options.description: Text Description of the global macro.

options.name: macro_name
options.description: Name of the global macro in zabbix native format C({$MACRO}) or simple format C(MACRO).

options.name: macro_type
options.description: Type of the global macro Text or Secret Text. Required if I(state=present). text secret - Secret Text Works only with Zabbix >= 5.0 and will default to Text in lower versions vault - Vault Secret Works only with Zabbix >= 5.2 and will default to Text in lower versions

options.name: macro_value
options.description: Value of the global macro. Required if I(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the macro. On C(present), it will create if macro does not exist or update the macro if the associated data is different. On C(absent) will remove a macro if it exists.
